new.s: Which of the following is a function of the National Development Council?
o: To audit the accounts of the Union and the States
To decide the share of States in central taxes
To ensure balanced development of all regions of the country
To estimate poverty at the national and state level
new.x: The NDC was set up to secure States' cooperation, mobilise resources, promote common economic policies and ensure balanced development of all regions.
